notes.title: Reverted back to the old physics system
notes.content:
Changes
- Reverted back to the old vehicle physics system
- Seasons mode is now replaced by trophies

notes.title: Unlimited ERS in Qualifying
notes.content:
Changes:
- Unlimited ERS in Qualifying to encourage multiple hot laps
- Reverted back to the old camera FOV
- Visual changes

Improvements:
- More gameplay optimizations

notes.title: General Improvements
notes.content:
Improvements:
- The vehicle collision now gets disabled only for the players who are a lap down.
- The size of the game has been reduced by half

Changes:
- The change in camera FOV when going fast is less drastic now
- Camera Far has been replaced by a new close up cam
- AI vehicles have been added in the tutorial

Bug Fixes:
- Jumping trees in some the tracks
- Engine mode in tutorial was always at 100%
- More lobby fixes
- The race pos of AI vehicles were not tracked when the number of real players were less than 3.

notes.title: New Seasons Mode with gems as reward
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added a new mode "Seasons" where a player starts from Division 10 and progresses based on their performance.
- Gems on now rewarded on the Seasons mode based on the division that the player is on.
- Lobby "Race" button can now be toggled by pressing the ctrl button instead of return button. Return button is now used to send messages on chat.

Improvements:
- Chat mode can be activated in the lobby by pressing the TAB button

Bug Fixes:
- Game mode selection was not working through keyboard or joystick

notes.title: You can now chat in Lobbies
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Ability to chat with other players has been added in the public and private lobbies
- The public lobby now automatically starts if the Host does not start a match in 30 seconds and the lobby has more than 1 player.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Reduced the max lap limit in the public lobby to 12 laps

notes.title: Updated the store with new Vehicle skins
notes.content:
Improvements:
- Added 5 new vehicle skins
- Fixed a few more issues with the lobby

notes.title: Fixed Lobby related bugs
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Issue where the user sometimes got kicked out from the lobby
- Lobby status sometimes did not get updated
- Race summary not getting displayed for non-hosts
- Exhaust kickback sound got played even when the game was muted
- The lobby Host leaving made the room unusable

notes.title: Equal Cars for All
notes.content:
Changes:
- Crew upgrades have been removed so that everyone can race with an Equal Car
- Players can only join Private Lobbies if they have a room code
- Duel mode has been removed due to massive wait times and lack of player interest
- Coins and Trophy Count have been removed as the game is not series based anymore
- Gift button has been added on the main menu where the players can get additional skins.

Improvements:
- Users can now practice while waiting for the lobby match to start
- Players get 50x more gems when making a purchase

Bug Fixes:
- Lap Stats was never shown again if the if the player went to in-game settings

notes.title: Revamped the Crew UI menu along with other optimizations
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Added option to change FPS in the settings menu
- Revamped the Crew UI Menu for better readability
- Fixed lag spike when the vehicles collided
- Added UI effects in the main menu
- Added a few vehicle effects
- Game Optimizations

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Reduced lobby summary duration from 10 secs to 5 secs
- Made changes to Third Person Cam far

notes.title: More Robost Lobby along with a new Series
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- Series 3 has been added in the duel 1v1 mode with Rain
- New Series 3 crew cards

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- The waiting lobby now gives more details regarding the ongoing race. ie: The current lap of the user, etc
- The waiting lobby shows if the player is new to the lobby or was already a part of the previous/ongoing race

[b]Changes:[/b]
- The required trophies to progress from Series 1 to 2 has been reduced to 60 trophies from 300 trophies.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Rejoining a lobby sometimes resulted in the player name showing up twice or not showing up at all
- Engine mode consume speed changed the tire wear too in the Lobby settings

notes.title: Time Trial mode has been added as a new standalone mode
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- Added time trial mode that features 4 different tracks to compete in each week
- Engine mode consumption speed has been added in the party lobby

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Manager mode has been removed from duel mode to reduce player segregation. It now only exists in the party lobby.
- Public and Private lobbies have been merged to reduce player segregation
- Users in duel mode now match with an AI if a user is not found for 300 seconds instead of 60
- #community-events channel has its own button in the Game Modes menu screen. 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Assist button did not appear if a user played a game in the manager mode followed by player mode

notes.title: Increase in Tire Life and Bug Fixes for the Manager Mode
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
- The Tire Life for the default Soft Tires has been increased from 1.5 Laps to 2 Laps
- The Tire Life for the default Medium Tires has been increased from 2 Laps to 3 Laps
- The Tire Life for the default Hard Tires has been increased from 3 Laps to 4 Laps

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed bug where the player got stuck when pitting for new tires
- Fixed issue where the AI difficulty was set to 100% even when the parameters were set to 150%

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Improved the dynamic AI in duel mode
- The AI player that the user is battling against now has a golden color name

notes.title: Added Manager Mode and Removed Pay to Win elements from the game
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- Manager Mode: A new mode that allows the player to focus less on driving and more on the strategic elements of the game
- Manager Mode has been added to the 1v1 duel mode and the public and private party lobby

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Chest Crew boxes cannot be bought from real money anymore. The only way to get them is by playing the game.
- Made some tweaks to the AI racing line

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Series 1 of 1v1 mode starts with 4 laps instead of 8 laps
- Reverted back to the old Engine mode consume and refill speed

notes.title: Improved visuals along with tutorial bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Improvements :[/b]
- Added option to enable real-time shadows in the settings menu
- Improved the flow of the tutorial

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Added rewards button on the Main menu screen
- Increased the size of the confetti and humans in the crowd
- Tweaked camera angles for all 3 camera types

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed issue where the tutorial was completely broken after the previous update

notes.title: New Persistent lobbies with tweakable parameters (Equal Cars, Total Laps, etc)
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- Tweakable Lobby Parameters: User can now choose the track he wants to race in along with the ability to tweak other parameters like Tire deg percentage, AI Difficulty, Qualifying time, Race laps, etc.
- Persistent Lobby: The game now remembers the lobby code and redirects the user to the lobby after the race ends. As a result the user does not have to generate a new lobby code every time. 
- Private and Public lobby: The user can now choose whether he wants to race on a public lobby or create their own private lobby

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Reverted back to the previous vehicle physics system where turning too much did not slow down the vehicle.
- Friendly Mode is now replaced by Public lobby
- The vehicle gets a lot slower when going through grass.
- Temporarily removed Track Oval and Track England from the Duel Mode.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed issue where the car showed "Tires are dead" as soon as the race started

notes.title: Added 1v1 Mode (Trophy Road) along with additional game tweaks
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- Added 1v1 mode: The game matches you with an opponent and you compete for trophies and coins.
- The players win percentage and win streak now gets displayed on the matchmaking screen
- Added Skid marks and Drift sound
- The Race start countdown timer is now replaced with a lights out screen

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- The sound of the vehicle mutes when a message popup is shown on the tutorial
- Made more improvements to the tutorial

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Tweaked the Topdown Camera angle
- Made changes to the AI difficulty
- Increased the vehicle turn sensitivity when going at high speeds
- Tweaked the tire life of all the tires
- Reduced the sound of the in game music

notes.title: Reduced the speed penalty when taking sharp turns and better sense of speed
notes.content:
Improvements:
- Reduced the speed penalty when taking a sharp turn
- Reduced the max duration a tire lasts when in cloudy weather
- Weather now affects the acceleration and not just the top speed

New Features:
- Added camera shake when going at fast speeds
- Added speed-based color effects
- Added "Camera Effects" toggle in the settings menu

notes.title: AI improvements and tweaks to the vehicle handling
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- AI grid is more spread out
- AI takes more time to leave the pitstop during Quali to reduce traffic
- AI does not pit when there's only one lap remaining

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Vehicle turn sensitivity is now dependent on the speed as well. So higher speed results in low turn sensitivity and vice versa.
- Reduced the speed penalty when taking sharper turns

notes.title: Room for more strategies along with new turning physics
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

- Track Temperature: The current weather affects the track temperature. Higher track temperature gives the vehicle a speed boost but also degrades the tires much faster. This creates room for more strategies. Eg: A one stop strategy could be possible when the weather is cloudy (low track temp) but it wont be possible if the weather is sunny.

- New Turning physics: The vehicle can take much sharper turns now. But the sharper you turn, the more speed you lose. This puts more emphasis on the racing line and makes the game more skill based, while still keeping it beginner friendly.

[b]Changes:[/b]

- Engine mode: The consumption speed of the engine battery has been increased so that the user cannot just push for the entire lap but instead has to push strategically. The refill speed has also been doubled to allow the user to push several times a lap.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Series 2 was only loading the Bahrain track

notes.title: Update 0.2.1: Improved Matchmaking System and more AI Vehicles
notes.content:
New Features:
- Matchmaking system now displays the race track that you'll be racing on, along with competition type, total laps and other game data 
- Added Matchmaking lobby so that you can practice while waiting before the race starts
- All 9 AI drivers now have their own unique set of dialogues

Changes:
- Reverted back to having a max of 9 AI vehicles
- Made some tweaks to the Camera FOV
- Reverted back to the previous car dimensions

notes.title: Update 0.2.1: Better sense of Speed
notes.content:
A new update is out with the following changes:

Bug Fixes:
- The track was not getting rendered in Italy and Italy Reverse
- Sound gets muted every time a race is completed
- Race End screen does not reset and shows lap times for the previous race
- New Camera angle not working on several tracks
- Camera facing the wrong direction on race start should happen less frequently (Hopefully)

Improvements:
- Vehicle now gets Transparent when collision is disabled
- Sense of speed has been improved when racing
- Increased the delay in calling "Tire Dead" dialogue from 10 secs to 15-20 secs
- Vehicle Tilt has been readded

notes.title: Update 0.2.0: Dynamic AI, Improved graphics and a new camera angle
notes.content:
New Features:
- Added Dynamic AI that changes its difficulty based on the race situation
- AI vehicles now have their own unique set of dialogues. And they say things based on how they are performing.
- Added a new camera angle (Third Person Far)
- Better graphics and lighting

Changes:
- AI vehicles are now limited to a max of 2
- Settings menu has been added on the tutorial
- Vehicles now say "Tire is gone" dialogue when their tires are less than 33 percent to remind the user to change their tires
- Info about Qualifying session has been added on the Quali intro screen to help new users understand the session structure.
- Game sound has been reduced
- Race Finish countdown timer gets displayed when 5 seconds are left for the race to get over instead of 20
- Reduced the size of the vehicles
- High resolution vehicle is rendered for the primary user
- Vehicle tilt effect has been removed 

Bug Fixes:
- Static sound when going through curbs has been disabled
- Issue where camera was facing the wrong direction on Race/Quali start has been fixed
- Issue where the collision got disabled when vehicles were racing wheel to wheel near the finish line.

notes.title: Update 0.1.9: Engine mode now affects Tire Degradation
notes.content:
[i]The game has been updated to v0.1.9[/i]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Setting the Engine mode on "High" degrades your tires faster when compared to "Normal" Engine mode. This adds another layer of strategy in deciding when to push or to conserve.
- Rain has been disabled in Series 1 to make it easier for new users to adapt into the game
- Assist mode is a bit stronger now
- ERS Engineer has been renamed to Power Unit Battery Engineer.
- The Default Wet tires now last for 3 laps instead of 4 laps
- Tire Engineers have been nerfed to allow room for more strategies in the later series.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- The tutorial has been remade with the intention of making the user feel less overwhelmed with new concepts

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Lag spike when vehicles collided with each other
- Host was unable to join the game in party mode when the number of users that joined the party was 10

notes.title: Update 0.1.8: PARTY MODE TO PLAY WITH UPTO 10 FRIENDS HAS BEEN ADDED
notes.content:
[i]The game has been updated to v0.1.8[/i]

- Added Party mode, you can now create/join a room code to play with upto 10 friends
- Vehicle now gets less transparent when collision is disabled
- Made the road materials a little less reflective
- Bug where the player name does not show up on the Match introduction screen should happen less frequently

notes.title: Update v0.1.7
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Added Weekly Online Fastest Lap Times on the Race Finish screen
- Ferris Wheel in Track Belgium has been removed as it blocked the view from the top-down camera

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Tire Degradation now affects the speed of the vehicle more prominently throughout rather than just making the car slower on 0% tire life. 
- Removed Camera Vibration

[b]Bug Fix:[/b]
- Incorrect Track image is displayed on the Match Found screen

notes.title: Update v0.1.6
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
- Tire grip: The way the tires interact with the track now changes depending on the tire life and weather conditions.
- Reduced Tire punishment - The speed punishment for being on the wrong tires has been reduced. Also, the speed punishment for being on 0% tire life has been reduced.
- AI Speed: Has been reduced for Series 1

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Collision System: Detecting when to enable/disable collision has been improved
- Visuals: Lighting has been improved

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Several Vehicles getting spawned for the same user
- AI vehicles appearing pink
- Camera shake when overlapping a player with collision disabled
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update v0.1.5
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
- Collision is disabled in Qualifying
- Collision is disabled when being overlapped
- Reduced the size of the HUD in the third person cam
[b]Bug Fix:[/b]
- Player sometimes goes through the pitlane and does not pit
- Lap count does not increment sometimes
- Sometimes, the player's position on the lap statistics appears to drop to last place, even though they are not actually in last place.
- AI Pitstop improvements

notes.title: Update v0.1.4
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
- The speed punishment is a lot higher when using dry tires on wet weather and wet tires on a dry surface.
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- The tire changes its color to the chosen tire compound instead of being red all the time
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update v0.1.3
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
- Tire Degradation has been disabled in the pitlane to prevent unfair advantage to those who have a pitbox in the front.
- Series 2 now includes the maps from Series 1 as well
- Soft Tires have been nerfed by 5%

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Game crashes during matchmaking/match found should be less frequent now
- Issue where choosing wet tires twice results in getting a soft tire has been fixed

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V0.1.2
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- New Third Person Chase Camera
- Minimap and Racing Line
[b]Changes:[/b]
- Reduced turn sensitivity now makes following the racing line more important
- Assist more is now much less prominent
- Tire compounds now last for the same amount of laps across all tracks. (Soft 2Laps, Medium 3Laps, Hard 4Laps, Wets 4Laps)
- Tire Degradation has been turned off in Qualifying to allow the users to set more laps
- The speed of the Hard tires has been reduced
- Pit Limiter speed has been increased
- Weather change duration has been increased
- AI is weaker initially and gets more powerful depending on the series that the user is in.
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- AI pitstop logic has been improved
- User cannot do a pitstop when entering the pitlane from the opposite direction
- Ghost mode gets enabled when the vehicle wants to pit and is near the pitlane
- For complete list check (https://trello.com/b/GqfMzeOw/formula-bwoah)
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Several bug fixes related to Matchmaking and game stability
- And more!

notes.title: More bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Added missing colliders in the tutorial screen
- More minor bug fixes

notes.title: Several Bug Fixes
notes.content:
The following bugs are fixed:
- The tire select UI does not reset on the next game which causes issues with the tire selection
- Rewards cannot be claimed with the controller
- The PS4 button icons are not correct
- The pitstop button and the respawn button are the same when using the joystick
- Reduced the speed of the Hard tires to 0.8 (From 0.9) and reduced the speed of medium tires to 0.9 (From 0.95). Soft tires still are 1.0
- Series reward gets stuck on loading when the trophy count is the exact same as the required trophy
- Connection error everytime a new game starts
- The billing system is not working
- Music is too loud
- Temporarily removed the quit button until the crash bug issue is fixed

notes.title: Connection Error Popup Hotfix
notes.content: Hot fix: Issue where the connection Error popup showed up after every game has been fixed.
